vol.name: Predator vs. the Planet of the Apes

title: Predator vs. the Planet of the Apes #5
desc:
THE FINAL FATE OF THE PLANET OF THE APES!

The war between the alien PREDATOR and the denizens of the PLANET OF THE APES reaches its epic conclusion!

And to the victor goes control of the ultimate weapon: the ALPHA-OMEGA BOMB!

Will DR. ZIRA, DR. CORNELIUS and their human ally ARCH manage to survive? Or will the Predator claim the entire planet as its latest trophy?!
